metadata.title: A sharp dyadic threshold in a characteristic-two random-cone construction
metadata.description: OpenAI's October 4 torsion-free group-algebra construction fixes a projective-plane order of 128. This note proves that 32 is the least dyadic order at least 4 at which the unchanged seven-extra squared turn weights admit exponential word-mass decay, using an exact three-class quotient and rational upper and lower certificates. Checking every affected estimate carries the source construction to a 532-edge rose. This is a model-specific threshold, not global generator optimality. Classical HNN embedding gives a two-generator realization; the scalar idempotent and absorbed nonzero cyclic projective right module are inherited consequences already recorded in public triage, and remain valid over every characteristic-two field. The matching is existential; no numerical group-ring multiplication certificate or full formalization is claimed. AI tools were used extensively in research, drafting and verification. The preprint has not undergone conventional human peer review or refereeing. No first-priority claim is made.
